title: Northern Tutchone language
extract: Northern Tutchone is an Athabaskan language of southern Yukon in Canada. About a little part of the Northern Tutchone people speak the language. Although they are sometimes considered separate languages, Northern and Southern Tutchone speakers are generally able to understand each other in conversation, albeit with moderate difficulty.
